response.sql: WITH filtered_standings AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, ds.points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), race_averages AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(points) AS race_avg FROM filtered_standings GROUP BY race_name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(race_avg) AS overall_average FROM race_averages) SELECT ra.race_name, ra.race_avg, ra.race_avg - oa.overall_average FROM race_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND ra.race_avg > oa.overall_average ORDER BY ra.race_name
